fix.item: Dashboard-specific CSS and JavaScript assets are now loaded deterministically on every xdecaro administrator dashboard layout.
Package child detection now uses each installed package manifest before falling back to package_id, preventing stale Joomla package relationships from mixing Forms and Courses extensions.

change.item: Redesigned dashboard metrics, diagnostics and information views for consistent spacing, readable hierarchy, responsive behavior and light/dark mode.
Package contents now expand below the product row into a structured extension table with an accessible animated toggle.
Extension and update counters now use descriptive labels instead of isolated numeric badges.
Update network behavior is presented in a separate information panel with a direct Joomla Updates action when permitted.

fix.item: Fixed administrator submenu links that could generate a duplicated index.php? prefix and fall back to com_cpanel with a 404 error.
Added upgrade-time normalization for menu rows already persisted by Core 1.5.0.

change.item: Added regression coverage for normalized dashboard submenu routes on clean installs and upgrades.

addition.item: Added the xdecaro administrator dashboard component to the Core package.
Added central product inventory with installed, missing, development and prerelease states.
Added installed and available version comparison using the Core catalog and Joomla update cache.
Added real package-child inspection for components, plugins, libraries and modules registered in Joomla.
Added local diagnostics for partial installations and disabled package plugins or modules.
Added responsive light/dark administrator UI and Italian/English language strings.

change.item: Commercial licensing remains intentionally inactive during development and does not block any installed feature.

addition.item: Added runtime in-memory CapabilityRegistry for optional product capability discovery.
Added minimum-version matching, component filtering and deterministic registry serialization.
Added registry smoke coverage for Notifications, Tasks and Analytics declarations.

change.item: Canonical PHP vendor namespace is now lowercase xdecaro\Core.
Added temporary Xdecaro\Core autoload compatibility for already-published consumers.
No public Core contract behavior, asset identifiers or package element changed.

addition.item: Added generic Capability integration contract for stable public capability identifiers.
Added generic IntegrationEvent envelope for optional cross-product events.
Added Notifications, Tasks and Analytics integration guidance and build validation.
Added the public AssetService for opt-in Joomla Web Asset Manager registration.
Added stable xdecaro.core and xdecaro.components style assets.
Added scoped responsive light/dark design tokens and shared UI primitives.
Added asset registry, media packaging and AssetService smoke validation.

change.item: Public product name standardized to Core by xdecaro.
Joomla-visible package, library, plugin and update labels updated.
Technical identifiers, namespace and integration APIs remain unchanged.

addition.item: Initial Core package with shared library and system plugin.
Stable EntityReference and RelationReference cross-product contracts.
Joomla 4, 5 and 6 compatible update channel.
Deterministic package build and SHA-256 release verification.
